description: This header file defines the 'dm_radio_list_t' class, which manages a list of radio devices, including initialization, database synchronization, configuration, and navigation of radio objects. It also includes methods for database operations, configuration management, and virtual functions for radio list traversal and manipulation.

classes.name: dm_radio_list_t
classes.description: A class that manages a list of radio devices, providing initialization, database synchronization, configuration, and navigation methods, along with several virtual functions for list traversal and manipulation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the radio list module, setting up necessary resources and configurations.

methods.name: get_dm_orch_type
methods.description: Retrieves the DM orchestration type associated with a specific radio from the database.

methods.name: update_list
methods.description: Updates the radio list with the specified operation type.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Deletes all entries from the radio list.

methods.name: init_table
methods.description: Initializes the radio list table, setting up data structures.

methods.name: init_columns
methods.description: Initializes the columns for displaying the radio list.

methods.name: sync_db
methods.description: Synchronizes the database with the given client and context.

methods.name: update_db
methods.description: Updates the database based on operation type and data.

methods.name: search_db
methods.description: Performs a database search using the provided key.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Compares the object with another 'db_easy_mesh_t' object for equality.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets the configuration in the database client using a JSON object.

methods.name: set_config (overloaded)
methods.description: Configures a specific radio using the database client.

methods.name: get_config (by object)
methods.description: Gets the radio list configuration based on a JSON object and parent ID.

methods.name: get_config (by JSON)
methods.description: Retrieves configuration settings, possibly with a summary flag.

methods.name: get_first_radio
methods.description: Pure virtual; retrieves the first radio in the list.

methods.name: get_next_radio
methods.description: Pure virtual; retrieves the next radio in the list.

methods.name: get_radio
methods.description: Pure virtual; retrieves a radio object based on a key.

methods.name: remove_radio
methods.description: Pure virtual; removes a radio entry identified by key.

methods.name: put_radio
methods.description: Pure virtual; adds a radio to the list with a key.
